name: Batman (The Dark Knight)
title: Gotham's Vengeance & Master Tactician

attacks.name: Explosive Batarang Volley
attacks.description: Flings high-speed titanium batarangs across footers, cards, and dark theme sections, severing them in clean arcs.

attacks.name: Bat-Grapple Element Slam
attacks.description: Fires high-tensile magnetic grapple cable onto page containers and slams them into the floor with immense torque.

attacks.name: Bat-Smoke Pellet Blackout
attacks.description: Detonates concussion smoke pellets that engulf page sections in darkness and collapse them into rubble.

voicelines: I am vengeance. I am the night. I am Batman!
It's not who I am underneath, but what DOM elements I destroy that defines me.
